### David Escapes Saul
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/david-escapes-saul
Passage: 1 Samuel 23:28-29
Points:
- David's path to the throne was filled with danger, forcing him to spend years fleeing an erratic and hostile king.
- In the wilderness, God sustained David through divine guidance and the refreshing encouragement of Jonathan's friendship.
- When Saul's troops were closing in on David, God used an unexpected Philistine invasion to divert the king away.
- The site was named the Rock of Escape to commemorate God's providential deliverance in a desperate moment.
- Believers facing severe trials can turn to Scripture for sure promises of God's presence, power, and protection.
